492c7f72-e986-43f1-aeb0-1690603a3461.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
492c7f72-e986-43f1-aeb0-1690603a3461.heading: Withdrawal from Bracket
492c7f72-e986-43f1-aeb0-1690603a3461.content:
23.B Withdrawal from Bracket. Players may withdraw from a bracket by
notifying the Tournament Director, Head Referee, or operations desk
personnel.

6e8b702e-2cc9-4315-a218-055b6db07491.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
6e8b702e-2cc9-4315-a218-055b6db07491.heading: 20.J Officiating Decision Challenge — Rescinding Challenge Request
6e8b702e-2cc9-4315-a218-055b6db07491.content:
20.J.1 Rescinding Challenge Request. After a request for the Head
Referee or Tournament Director has been acknowledged by the
referee, the player may rescind the request; however, the player
or team will be charged a standard time-out. When a standard
time-out is not available, the referee will assess a technical foul
against the player or team.

9ff99361-b2c0-4345-9f43-1c2d75642d59.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
9ff99361-b2c0-4345-9f43-1c2d75642d59.heading: 23.A Retirement from Match — Advance Notification of Retirement
9ff99361-b2c0-4345-9f43-1c2d75642d59.content:
23.A.2 Advance Notification of Retirement. A singles player or
doubles team may request a retirement in advance of any
upcoming match by notifying the Tournament Director, Head
Referee, or operations desk personnel.

88d2227c-ad04-4872-8660-3f80d2518d25.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
88d2227c-ad04-4872-8660-3f80d2518d25.heading: Replay – Net System Malfunction
88d2227c-ad04-4872-8660-3f80d2518d25.section: Section 13: The Net and Net Support
88d2227c-ad04-4872-8660-3f80d2518d25.content:
13.J Replay – Net System Malfunction. When a net system malfunctions during
a rally, the rally must be replayed.

e05db4f0-e98a-4336-8ca0-895bf80fb21f.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
e05db4f0-e98a-4336-8ca0-895bf80fb21f.heading: 18.F Reporting for Match — Match Forfeit – No Show for Multiple-Game Match
e05db4f0-e98a-4336-8ca0-895bf80fb21f.content:
18.F.2 Match Forfeit – No Show for Multiple-Game Match. In a multiple-
game match, when a player fails to report to play within 15
minutes after the match has been called to play, the referee will
impose a match forfeit on the player, unless the Tournament
Director grants a delay of the match start for extenuating
circumstances. (See Rule 16.M.)

2be43ec1-5da0-4a6c-b3f7-542f29d33c1b.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
2be43ec1-5da0-4a6c-b3f7-542f29d33c1b.heading: 18.F Reporting for Match — Game or Match Forfeit – No Show for First Game
2be43ec1-5da0-4a6c-b3f7-542f29d33c1b.content:
18.F.1 Game or Match Forfeit – No Show for First Game. When a player
fails to report to play within 10 minutes after the match has been
called to play, the referee will impose a game forfeit on the player,
unless the Tournament Director grants a delay of the match start
for extenuating circumstances. If the match format is one game,
the game forfeit will result in a match forfeit.

6ab02200-ccd1-474d-a263-c636a75506b3.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
6ab02200-ccd1-474d-a263-c636a75506b3.heading: 21.A Standard Time-Out — Duration
6ab02200-ccd1-474d-a263-c636a75506b3.content:
21.A.5 Duration. A maximum of one minute is allowed for each
standard time-out.

5f703df6-84af-4ff8-8f2c-eaf7670a0db5.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
5f703df6-84af-4ff8-8f2c-eaf7670a0db5.heading: 22.D Technical Fouls — Invalid Medical Time-Out Request – No Time-Out
5f703df6-84af-4ff8-8f2c-eaf7670a0db5.content:
22.D.6 Invalid Medical Time-Out Request – No Time-Out. Requesting
a medical time-out when no valid medical condition exists and a
standard time-out is not available to be charged. See Rule
21.C.10.

0937bb3e-664e-4b31-9ad4-f6608578ff46.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
0937bb3e-664e-4b31-9ad4-f6608578ff46.heading: 22.B Verbal and Technical Warnings — Invalid Medical Time-Out Request – Time-Out Charged.
0937bb3e-664e-4b31-9ad4-f6608578ff46.content:
22.B.9 Invalid Medical Time-Out Request – Time-Out Charged.
Requesting a medical time-out when no valid medical condition
exists. (A verbal warning is not applicable.) A standard time-out
is also charged. See Rule 21.C.10.

7e1e9097-f078-40e4-8420-559783f2b5d9.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
7e1e9097-f078-40e4-8420-559783f2b5d9.heading: Starting Server Identification (Doubles)
7e1e9097-f078-40e4-8420-559783f2b5d9.content:
16.H Starting Server Identification (Doubles). The Tournament Director will
provide a method of identifying each team’s starting server for each game.

1bc2673d-8f28-4c74-a785-2f0496568a50.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
1bc2673d-8f28-4c74-a785-2f0496568a50.heading: 21.F Time-Out Between Games — End Change and Initial Service Change
1bc2673d-8f28-4c74-a785-2f0496568a50.content:
21.F.2 End Change and Initial Service Change. Singles players or
doubles teams must change ends and initial service for the next
game of the match.

5345b056-5071-482e-9cc7-2a83617b6d35.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
5345b056-5071-482e-9cc7-2a83617b6d35.heading: 21.B End Change Time-Out — Failure to Change Ends
5345b056-5071-482e-9cc7-2a83617b6d35.content:
21.B.7 Failure to Change Ends. When an end change is not executed at
the required point score, the end change will be executed when
the failure to change ends is detected. It is not a fault on either
team, the score is not impacted, and service continues with the
same server.

304529b8-1c7f-4206-b6b6-a36f1cc3d909.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
304529b8-1c7f-4206-b6b6-a36f1cc3d909.heading: End Change Time-Out
304529b8-1c7f-4206-b6b6-a36f1cc3d909.content:
21.B End Change Time-Out. The referee will call a time-out to allow players to
change ends at specified points during single-game matches and tie-
breaker games. Players will not change ends during the tie-breaker game
when the first game of the match was forfeited due to late arrival.
21.B.1 11-Point Game. In a single game or tie-breaker game to 11
points, the players will change ends when the first singles player
or doubles team reaches a score of 6.
21.B.2 15-Point Game. In a single game or tie-breaker game to 15
points, the players will change ends when the first singles player
or doubles team reaches a score of 8.
21.B.3 21-Point Game. In a single game or tie-breaker game to 21
points, the players will change ends when the first singles player
or doubles team reaches a score of 11.

21e73451-00d3-4b01-96e5-bba3b2d7662b.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
21e73451-00d3-4b01-96e5-bba3b2d7662b.heading: 21.B End Change Time-Out — No Server Change
21e73451-00d3-4b01-96e5-bba3b2d7662b.content:
21.B.4 No Server Change. After an end change time-out, play
continues with the same server.

6805b9c2-4488-4763-bb4b-ed09ed7ad47b.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
6805b9c2-4488-4763-bb4b-ed09ed7ad47b.heading: 21.B End Change Time-Out — Loss of End Change Point
6805b9c2-4488-4763-bb4b-ed09ed7ad47b.content:
21.B.6 Loss of End Change Point. A technical foul resulting in the loss
of the end change point will have no effect on the completed
end change.

4224cde5-1c9e-4a82-8632-34b9fd6ad65e.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
4224cde5-1c9e-4a82-8632-34b9fd6ad65e.heading: 3.D.6 Allowable Alterations — Changes to the grip size via inserts.
4224cde5-1c9e-4a82-8632-34b9fd6ad65e.content: 3.D.6.g Changes to the grip size via inserts.

bc191c12-071e-41a8-b571-3083327a288f.title: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
bc191c12-071e-41a8-b571-3083327a288f.content:
1.2. To determine the team that decides the serve, receive, side or defer options, use the 1 / 2
method or other mutually agreed option.
1.3. No time outs are allowed except for medical or equipment issues.
1.4. Optional End Change: Prior to the start of the Picklebreaker, both teams may mutually
agree to switch ends when the first team reaches six (8) points (15-point game) or thirteen
(13) points (25-point game). If both teams do not agree before play begins, no end change
shall occur during the entire game.

b926746e-4004-4001-a20b-9c2664982b7e.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
b926746e-4004-4001-a20b-9c2664982b7e.heading: 21.B End Change Time-Out — Duration
b926746e-4004-4001-a20b-9c2664982b7e.content:
21.B.5 Duration. A maximum of one minute is allowed to change ends
during a game.

4e562ffc-5ed0-481b-95e3-fbce26afbb35.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
4e562ffc-5ed0-481b-95e3-fbce26afbb35.heading: 21.B End Change Time-Out — Resuming Play
4e562ffc-5ed0-481b-95e3-fbce26afbb35.content:
21.B.8 Resuming Play. The referee will resume play by announcing a
15-second warning (Rule 17.D.16).

3a31bbad-c907-4fae-949f-7ab726be5095.title: LWR Pickleball Club Code of Conduct
3a31bbad-c907-4fae-949f-7ab726be5095.content:
1. Standard of Play & Sportsmanship
• Golden Rule: Treat every player, regardless of skill level, with the same respect you
expect to receive.
• Positive Environment: Support your partners and remain respectful to your
opponents. Avoid "trash talk" that crosses the line into being mean-spirited or
discouraging.
• Integrity of the Game: Players must make line calls that are "clear and certain." In
accordance with standard pickleball officiating, all "close" calls must be resolved in
favor of the opponent.
• Player Integrity: Any attempt to manipulate ratings through "sandbagging,"
reporting false scores, or intentionally losing matches is strictly prohibited and
grounds for immediate expulsion.
• On-Court Decorum: Profanity, paddle throwing, or aggressive physical gestures
toward opponents, partners, or spectators will not be tolerated.

046bc36a-fd28-48a4-8080-5f492f3dcc3f.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
046bc36a-fd28-48a4-8080-5f492f3dcc3f.heading: Definitions
046bc36a-fd28-48a4-8080-5f492f3dcc3f.content:
Section 2 Definitions
Ball In Play. The timeframe during which a rally is played, from when the serve is
hit until the ball becomes dead.
Carry. Hitting the ball in such a way that it does not bounce away from the paddle
but is carried along on the face of the paddle.
Coaching. Communication of information (including verbal, nonverbal, and
electronic) from someone other than a player’s partner, that players may act upon
to gain an advantage or help them avoid a rules violation.
Court. The area inside the outer dimensions of the baselines and sidelines.
Dead Ball. A ball that is no longer in play.
Distraction. Physical actions by a player that are not common to the game and
interfere with the opponent’s ability or concentration to hit the ball. Examples
include, but are not limited to, making loud noises, stomping feet, and
waving the paddle in an erratic manner.
Double Bounce. When the ball bounces twice on one end of the net before it is
returned.
Double Hit. Hitting the ball twice before it is returned.
Drop Serve. A serve made by dropping the ball and hitting the ball with the paddle
after the ball bounces on the playing surface.
Ejection. Removal of a player from tournament competition for a flagrant or
injurious behavioral violation.
Expulsion. Banishment of a player from the tournament venue for a flagrant or
injurious behavioral violation.
Fault. A rules violation that results in a dead ball and the loss of a rally.
First Server (Doubles). The player who begins the team’s service rotation from
the right serving area after a side out.
Forfeit. The awarding of a game or a match to the opponent due to a violation of
the rules.
Hinder. Any transient element or occurrence not caused by a player that adversely
impacts play. Examples include, but are not limited to, stray balls, flying insects,

ced81878-886a-415a-91d3-fff8cd4caf17.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
ced81878-886a-415a-91d3-fff8cd4caf17.heading: 3.D.6 Allowable Alterations — Handwritten pen markings on the paddle surface for
ced81878-886a-415a-91d3-fff8cd4caf17.content:
3.D.6.i Handwritten pen markings on the paddle surface for
identification purposes only (name, signature, phone,
email address), or an autograph. No aftermarket
graphics are allowed on a commercially made paddle.

4da256ff-d390-47d4-8183-dfa45286f107.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
4da256ff-d390-47d4-8183-dfa45286f107.heading: 3.C Ball Specifications — Construction
4da256ff-d390-47d4-8183-dfa45286f107.content:
3.C.5 Construction. The ball must be made of durable material molded
with a smooth surface and free of texturing. The ball may have a
slight ridge at the seam, as long as it does not significantly impact
the ball’s flight characteristics. (See Figure 3-2.)
The ball with larger holes is customarily used
for indoor play (pictured on the left). The ball
with smaller holes is customarily used for
outdoor play (pictured on the right).
Figure 3-2: Approved Balls – Examples

fd2759b3-470e-4d63-b60e-621fab8d79aa.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
fd2759b3-470e-4d63-b60e-621fab8d79aa.heading: Damaged Ball
fd2759b3-470e-4d63-b60e-621fab8d79aa.content:
10.G Damaged Ball. When a ball is or becomes broken, cracked, soft or degraded,
play must continue until the end of the rally. The ball will be replaced if all
players agree.

1e09db6a-5bc3-4d3a-93da-dee412126994.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
1e09db6a-5bc3-4d3a-93da-dee412126994.heading: Ball Around Net Post
1e09db6a-5bc3-4d3a-93da-dee412126994.section: Section 13: The Net and Net Support
1e09db6a-5bc3-4d3a-93da-dee412126994.content:
13.C Ball Around Net Post. A ball may be returned around the outside of the net
post.

5fd78215-565f-43cf-855f-89c7e1a2b385.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
5fd78215-565f-43cf-855f-89c7e1a2b385.heading: Extra Ball
5fd78215-565f-43cf-855f-89c7e1a2b385.content:
24.B Extra Ball. An extra ball carried by a player during a rally must not be
visible to the opponent and must remain in possession of the player.

cce58f04-0041-4a04-88dd-aab052122700.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
cce58f04-0041-4a04-88dd-aab052122700.heading: Damaged Ball
cce58f04-0041-4a04-88dd-aab052122700.content:
20.F Damaged Ball. A player may appeal to the referee to determine whether a
ball is degraded, soft, broken, or cracked. A potentially soft or degraded
ball will not be replaced unless all players agree. If the referee determines
that the ball is broken or cracked, it will be replaced. (Modifies Rule 10.G)

4e45501b-d487-403e-92eb-e249a68c35b3.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
4e45501b-d487-403e-92eb-e249a68c35b3.heading: 24.B Extra Ball — Fault – Extra Ball Visible or Ball Falls
4e45501b-d487-403e-92eb-e249a68c35b3.content:
24.B.1 Fault – Extra Ball Visible or Ball Falls. When an extra ball
carried by a player is visible to an opponent or falls to the
playing surface while the ball is live, it is a fault against the
player.

edf08dcc-eea1-4468-92cc-987bf1b49387.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
edf08dcc-eea1-4468-92cc-987bf1b49387.heading: 13.I Player Crossing Plane of Net — Ball Crosses Back to Opponent’s Side
edf08dcc-eea1-4468-92cc-987bf1b49387.section: Section 13: The Net and Net Support
edf08dcc-eea1-4468-92cc-987bf1b49387.content:
13.I.2 Ball Crosses Back to Opponent’s Side. When a ball bounces in the
court on the receiving player’s end of the net and then returns to
the opponent’s side of the net without being hit, the receiving
player may cross over, under, or around the net to hit the ball, but
only after the ball has first crossed back to the opponent’s end of
the net.

71db4adc-1433-4b33-aa1e-3ce522904cb7.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
71db4adc-1433-4b33-aa1e-3ce522904cb7.heading: 7.B Ball Release — No Manipulation or Spin Upon Release
71db4adc-1433-4b33-aa1e-3ce522904cb7.content:
7.B.2 No Manipulation or Spin Upon Release. Some natural rotation of
the ball is expected during any release of the ball. The server must
not manipulate the ball to add spin with any part of the server's
body or the paddle prior to hitting the ball to make the serve,
except that the server may allow the ball to roll off the face of the
paddle by gravity. Spin may be applied to the ball upon contact by
the paddle.

a52acb37-df57-4095-ba36-c88f766208d8.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
a52acb37-df57-4095-ba36-c88f766208d8.heading: Ball Contacting Net
a52acb37-df57-4095-ba36-c88f766208d8.section: Section 13: The Net and Net Support
a52acb37-df57-4095-ba36-c88f766208d8.content:
13.A Ball Contacting Net. When the ball contacts the net, or the rope or cable at
the top of the net between the net posts, the ball remains in play.

5c908a00-ddeb-4dd4-854f-acc798b2f5b5.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
5c908a00-ddeb-4dd4-854f-acc798b2f5b5.heading: Ball Contacting Net Support System
5c908a00-ddeb-4dd4-854f-acc798b2f5b5.section: Section 13: The Net and Net Support
5c908a00-ddeb-4dd4-854f-acc798b2f5b5.content:
13.B Ball Contacting Net Support System. A served ball must not contact any
part of the net support system. A returned ball must not contact any part of
the net support system on the hitting player’s end of the net.

70227caf-df96-48de-be82-423359276556.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
70227caf-df96-48de-be82-423359276556.heading: 22.D Technical Fouls — Ball Abuse
70227caf-df96-48de-be82-423359276556.content:
22.D.2 Ball Abuse. Aggressively or recklessly throwing or hitting a dead
ball in frustration or anger with negligent disregard for the
consequences as long as the ball does not strike a person but
puts a person at risk or in danger.

c93a4343-347d-47e5-be63-0670c93b32e8.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
c93a4343-347d-47e5-be63-0670c93b32e8.heading: Ball Crossing Plane of Net
c93a4343-347d-47e5-be63-0670c93b32e8.section: Section 13: The Net and Net Support
c93a4343-347d-47e5-be63-0670c93b32e8.content:
13.F Ball Crossing Plane of Net. A ball must entirely cross to a player’s end of
the net before the player hits the ball.

95668a6f-ea73-4656-93ec-9bead779791c.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
95668a6f-ea73-4656-93ec-9bead779791c.heading: 25.B.3 Two-Bounce Allowance — Dead Ball
95668a6f-ea73-4656-93ec-9bead779791c.content:
25.B.3.d Dead Ball. When the ball strikes a permanent object
(e.g., fence, wall) before the second bounce, it is a
dead ball and the rally ends.

5d243230-4ca1-4e51-b497-8aed968bdced.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
5d243230-4ca1-4e51-b497-8aed968bdced.heading: 13.B Ball Contacting Net Support System — Replay – Ball Affected by Net Support System
5d243230-4ca1-4e51-b497-8aed968bdced.section: Section 13: The Net and Net Support
5d243230-4ca1-4e51-b497-8aed968bdced.content:
13.B.2 Replay – Ball Affected by Net Support System. When a returned
ball crosses the net and contacts any part of a crossbar, or any
other part of the net support system within the court boundaries,
before or after the ball bounces, the rally must be replayed.

fdc738a1-09f6-4fd3-b839-f33196e9fa24.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
fdc738a1-09f6-4fd3-b839-f33196e9fa24.heading: 10.C Returned Ball Placement — Fault – Ball Hits Permanent Object After Landing
fdc738a1-09f6-4fd3-b839-f33196e9fa24.content:
10.C.5 Fault – Ball Hits Permanent Object After Landing. When a player
fails to return a ball that has bounced in the player’s court before
the ball contacts a permanent object, it is a fault against that
player.

28b15ab9-6072-4cbd-a1fc-63d80d1fe78e.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
28b15ab9-6072-4cbd-a1fc-63d80d1fe78e.heading: 13.I.2 Ball Crosses Back to Opponent’s Side — Fault – Ball Not Contacted
28b15ab9-6072-4cbd-a1fc-63d80d1fe78e.section: Section 13: The Net and Net Support
28b15ab9-6072-4cbd-a1fc-63d80d1fe78e.content:
13.I.2.b Fault – Ball Not Contacted. When a ball bounces in
the court on the receiving player’s end of the net and
then returns to the opponent’s end of the net without
being hit, it is a fault against a player who fails to hit
the ball before it bounces once on the opponent’s end
of the net.

be42b685-ba0f-45f0-b67d-8f9b8e975aef.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
be42b685-ba0f-45f0-b67d-8f9b8e975aef.heading: 13.B Ball Contacting Net Support System — Fault – Ball Contacts Net Support System
be42b685-ba0f-45f0-b67d-8f9b8e975aef.section: Section 13: The Net and Net Support
be42b685-ba0f-45f0-b67d-8f9b8e975aef.content:
13.B.1 Fault – Ball Contacts Net Support System. When a player serves a
ball that contacts the net support system on either end of the net
or returns a ball that contacts the net support system before going
over the net, it is a fault against the player.

b8f58b72-95f2-4458-8d7d-56a01c3863ef.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
b8f58b72-95f2-4458-8d7d-56a01c3863ef.heading: 22.B Verbal and Technical Warnings — Ball Abuse
b8f58b72-95f2-4458-8d7d-56a01c3863ef.content:
22.B.4 Ball Abuse. Intentionally damaging or aggressively hitting a
dead ball without endangering people.

74afc642-d9ab-4ecb-809f-587be65c13fd.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
74afc642-d9ab-4ecb-809f-587be65c13fd.heading: 20.E.2 Replays — Replay – Ball Release Not Visible
74afc642-d9ab-4ecb-809f-587be65c13fd.content:
20.E.2.a Replay – Ball Release Not Visible. When it is
questionable whether the release of the ball was not
visible to the referee and receiver, the referee may
call for a replay. When the referee is certain that the
release of the ball was not visible, the referee must
call for a replay.

d8460364-0a11-470e-915f-0e93a69f6008.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
d8460364-0a11-470e-915f-0e93a69f6008.heading: 13.F Ball Crossing Plane of Net — Fault – Ball Hit Before Crossing Plane of Net
d8460364-0a11-470e-915f-0e93a69f6008.section: Section 13: The Net and Net Support
d8460364-0a11-470e-915f-0e93a69f6008.content:
13.F.1 Fault – Ball Hit Before Crossing Plane of Net. When a player hits
the ball before the ball entirely crosses the plane of the net to the
player’s end, it is a fault against the player.

8723a303-e41c-470a-ae08-95866948f5c0.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
8723a303-e41c-470a-ae08-95866948f5c0.heading: 10.G Damaged Ball — No Replay – Soft or Degraded Ball
8723a303-e41c-470a-ae08-95866948f5c0.content:
10.G.2 No Replay – Soft or Degraded Ball. When a ball is or becomes
degraded or soft, the result of the prior rally stands.

ed8c18f7-388c-4371-b103-0b8199043084.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
ed8c18f7-388c-4371-b103-0b8199043084.heading: 7.B Ball Release — Visible Release
ed8c18f7-388c-4371-b103-0b8199043084.content:
7.B.3 Visible Release. The server’s release of the ball must be visible to
the receiver.

c4d4d62d-5d10-41b7-ac61-aece86f7e184.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
c4d4d62d-5d10-41b7-ac61-aece86f7e184.heading: Ball Under Net
c4d4d62d-5d10-41b7-ac61-aece86f7e184.section: Section 13: The Net and Net Support
c4d4d62d-5d10-41b7-ac61-aece86f7e184.content: 13.E Ball Under Net. A ball must not be hit under the net.

76cecd1c-f034-4e13-94d3-d9e660645631.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
76cecd1c-f034-4e13-94d3-d9e660645631.heading: Dead Balls, Faults, and Hinders
76cecd1c-f034-4e13-94d3-d9e660645631.section: Section 9: Dead Balls, Faults, and Hinders
76cecd1c-f034-4e13-94d3-d9e660645631.content: Section 9 Dead Balls, Faults, and Hinders

fb9a3d49-06ca-4889-98fc-c061104979ce.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
fb9a3d49-06ca-4889-98fc-c061104979ce.heading: 7.B.3 Visible Release — Replay – Ball Release Not Visible
fb9a3d49-06ca-4889-98fc-c061104979ce.content:
7.B.3.a Replay – Ball Release Not Visible. When the receiver
cannot see the release of the ball, the receiver may call
for a replay, but only before the return of serve.

13bdbbf3-1395-4635-8fa5-fc12dfe3628b.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
13bdbbf3-1395-4635-8fa5-fc12dfe3628b.heading: Wheelchair, Adaptive Standing,
13bdbbf3-1395-4635-8fa5-fc12dfe3628b.content:
Section 25 Wheelchair, Adaptive Standing,
and Hybrid Doubles Play

a686d462-12c2-4b02-90c6-2e763371aacf.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
a686d462-12c2-4b02-90c6-2e763371aacf.heading: Confirmation of Correct Player or Position
a686d462-12c2-4b02-90c6-2e763371aacf.content:
20.B Confirmation of Correct Player or Position. Before the serve is hit, any
player may ask the referee to confirm the correct server, correct receiver,
and correct player positions. (Modifies Rule 5.C)

381c3052-d8c2-4fd1-be21-d4cee4cb0341.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
381c3052-d8c2-4fd1-be21-d4cee4cb0341.heading: 25.A.12 Tournament Events — Replay – Questionable Wheel Contact with
381c3052-d8c2-4fd1-be21-d4cee4cb0341.content:
25.A.12.b Replay – Questionable Wheel Contact with
Serving Area. When it is questionable whether
both wheels of the server’s wheelchair were in
contact with the serving area when the serve was
hit, the referee may call for a replay. (Modifies Rule
20.E.2.d)

8fe2ae0a-f1b3-41c4-aaf3-04485e0318b3.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
8fe2ae0a-f1b3-41c4-aaf3-04485e0318b3.heading: 25.A.12 Tournament Events — Replay – Questionable Wheel Contact Outside
8fe2ae0a-f1b3-41c4-aaf3-04485e0318b3.content:
25.A.12.c Replay – Questionable Wheel Contact Outside
the Serving Area. When it is questionable whether
a large rear wheel of the server’s wheelchair was in
contact with the playing surface outside the
serving area when the serve was hit, the referee
may call for a replay. (Modifies Rule 20.E.2.e)

1b3820cf-559a-46d3-a305-1424f3a57ef4.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
1b3820cf-559a-46d3-a305-1424f3a57ef4.heading: 25.B.2 Assistive Devices — Prohibited Use
1b3820cf-559a-46d3-a305-1424f3a57ef4.content:
25.B.2.b Prohibited Use. Assistive devices must not be used
to strike the ball or to intentionally alter its flight. If
an assistive device contacts a live ball, the ball
becomes dead and the rally ends.

21b70f61-c181-4bd8-99bc-40065f4bd941.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
21b70f61-c181-4bd8-99bc-40065f4bd941.heading: 25.B.3 Two-Bounce Allowance — Fault – Failure to Return Ball Before Third Bounce.
21b70f61-c181-4bd8-99bc-40065f4bd941.content:
25.B.3.c Fault – Failure to Return Ball Before Third Bounce.
When the player does not return a ball before it
bounces three times, it is a fault against the player.
(Modifies Rule 10.B.1.)

e0198b10-1270-4d2a-9b63-316cb4166e39.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
e0198b10-1270-4d2a-9b63-316cb4166e39.heading: 13.I.1 After Hitting the Ball — Fault – Player Crosses Plane of Net Without Hitting
e0198b10-1270-4d2a-9b63-316cb4166e39.section: Section 13: The Net and Net Support
e0198b10-1270-4d2a-9b63-316cb4166e39.content:
13.I.1.b Fault – Player Crosses Plane of Net Without Hitting
Ball. When any part of a player or anything that is worn
or carried by the player crosses the plane of the net
and the player does not hit the ball, it is a fault against
the player.

fb6b00a0-8ee3-4306-babe-4fb14a1d42a0.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
fb6b00a0-8ee3-4306-babe-4fb14a1d42a0.heading: 13.I.1 After Hitting the Ball — Fault – Player Crosses Plane of Net Before Hitting
fb6b00a0-8ee3-4306-babe-4fb14a1d42a0.section: Section 13: The Net and Net Support
fb6b00a0-8ee3-4306-babe-4fb14a1d42a0.content:
13.I.1.a Fault – Player Crosses Plane of Net Before Hitting
Ball. When any part of a player or anything that is worn
or carried by the player crosses the plane of the net
before the player hits the ball, it is a fault against the
player.

1535e802-5b06-4a88-bce6-407c938cca47.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
1535e802-5b06-4a88-bce6-407c938cca47.heading: Faults
1535e802-5b06-4a88-bce6-407c938cca47.section: Section 9: Dead Balls, Faults, and Hinders
1535e802-5b06-4a88-bce6-407c938cca47.content: 9.B Faults. A called fault or a fault committed by a player results in a dead ball.

c47bfdb1-c67f-463f-9b48-c77623818550.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
c47bfdb1-c67f-463f-9b48-c77623818550.heading: 10.C Returned Ball Placement — Fault – Ball Lands on Player’s Side of Net
c47bfdb1-c67f-463f-9b48-c77623818550.content:
10.C.2 Fault – Ball Lands on Player’s Side of Net. When a player hits a
ball that fails to cross the net and lands on the player’s side of the
net, it is a fault against that player.

b6b3711e-a8fa-4826-8f78-3b873f08c006.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
b6b3711e-a8fa-4826-8f78-3b873f08c006.heading: 13.E Ball Under Net — Fault – Ball Under Net
b6b3711e-a8fa-4826-8f78-3b873f08c006.section: Section 13: The Net and Net Support
b6b3711e-a8fa-4826-8f78-3b873f08c006.content:
13.E.1 Fault – Ball Under Net. When a player hits the ball under the net, it
is a fault against the player.

8a66c25a-2576-46be-92c6-d6f85ac22445.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
8a66c25a-2576-46be-92c6-d6f85ac22445.heading: Ball Between Net and Net Post
8a66c25a-2576-46be-92c6-d6f85ac22445.section: Section 13: The Net and Net Support
8a66c25a-2576-46be-92c6-d6f85ac22445.content:
13.D Ball Between Net and Net Post. A ball must not be hit between the net and
the net post.

d5efe92a-597a-44bd-acf4-0d3c18010554.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
d5efe92a-597a-44bd-acf4-0d3c18010554.heading: 15.C.1 Standard Scoring Formats — Best 2-of-3 games to 11 points.

bd5cd647-083b-4220-ac5a-0a1cdc0d3953.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
bd5cd647-083b-4220-ac5a-0a1cdc0d3953.heading: 15.C.1 Standard Scoring Formats — Best 3-of-5 games to 11 points.

af45fef4-2236-4d4b-81a1-c3d6d155c5b2.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
af45fef4-2236-4d4b-81a1-c3d6d155c5b2.heading: 21.F Time-Out Between Games — Resuming Play
af45fef4-2236-4d4b-81a1-c3d6d155c5b2.content:
21.F.4 Resuming Play. The referee will resume play by announcing a
15-second warning (Rule 17.D.16).

a1a21f16-2ac5-4535-a2ff-921bcd7e9b1f.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
a1a21f16-2ac5-4535-a2ff-921bcd7e9b1f.heading: 21.D Referee Time-Out — Resuming Play
a1a21f16-2ac5-4535-a2ff-921bcd7e9b1f.content:
21.D.4 Resuming Play. The referee will resume play by announcing a
15-second warning (Rule 17.D.16).

a474b693-4b76-428a-b08a-66412fc5e80c.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
a474b693-4b76-428a-b08a-66412fc5e80c.heading: Reporting for Match
a474b693-4b76-428a-b08a-66412fc5e80c.content:
18.F Reporting for Match. Players must report to play a match within 10 minutes
after the match is called. A match cannot begin until all players are present
and the starting score is called.

43a66406-9527-4ca6-b727-b616a417d227.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
43a66406-9527-4ca6-b727-b616a417d227.heading: 15.C.2 (Provisional Rule) Rally Scoring Match Formats — One game to 11 points, 15 points, or 21 points.
43a66406-9527-4ca6-b727-b616a417d227.content: 15.C.2.a One game to 11 points, 15 points, or 21 points.

6b64bfd9-2dcc-420a-a368-a4cad4a6adc5.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
6b64bfd9-2dcc-420a-a368-a4cad4a6adc5.heading: 21.C Medical Time-Out — Number Available
6b64bfd9-2dcc-420a-a368-a4cad4a6adc5.content:
21.C.3 Number Available. A player may be granted only one medical
time-out per match.

f85769cb-18c6-4e8c-84d8-0d7a65555199.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
f85769cb-18c6-4e8c-84d8-0d7a65555199.heading: 25.A Wheelchair Play — Playing Surface Dimensions
f85769cb-18c6-4e8c-84d8-0d7a65555199.content:
25.A.11 Playing Surface Dimensions. The recommended playing
surface area for wheelchair play is 44 feet (13.41 m) wide and
74 feet (22.55 m) long. The recommended playing surface area
for wheelchair play in a stadium court is 50 feet (15.24 m) wide
by 80 feet (24.38 m) long. (Modifies Rule 3.A.3)

46b8b96e-5df6-4b8a-9914-b338e557eff2.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
46b8b96e-5df6-4b8a-9914-b338e557eff2.heading: 6.E Stop Play Indicators — Question About the Score
46b8b96e-5df6-4b8a-9914-b338e557eff2.section: Section 6: Player Readiness and Calling the
46b8b96e-5df6-4b8a-9914-b338e557eff2.content:
6.E.1 Question About the Score. Before the serve is hit, a player may
ask their opponent for the correct score. The opponent must
respond with the appropriate information.

63dbf287-2932-4b9a-a116-c6d62b014150.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
63dbf287-2932-4b9a-a116-c6d62b014150.heading: Readiness
63dbf287-2932-4b9a-a116-c6d62b014150.section: Section 6: Player Readiness and Calling the
63dbf287-2932-4b9a-a116-c6d62b014150.content:
6.A Readiness. Before the start of the score call, any player may signal they are
not ready to start play.

b3a6f610-bfa9-437c-9b7f-1c90182e6288.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
b3a6f610-bfa9-437c-9b7f-1c90182e6288.heading: When to Serve
b3a6f610-bfa9-437c-9b7f-1c90182e6288.section: Section 6: Player Readiness and Calling the
b3a6f610-bfa9-437c-9b7f-1c90182e6288.content:
6.C When to Serve. The entire score must be called before the server hits the
serve.

2c4206cb-e198-45ab-9387-efe231d61f60.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
2c4206cb-e198-45ab-9387-efe231d61f60.heading: Calling the Score
2c4206cb-e198-45ab-9387-efe231d61f60.section: Section 6: Player Readiness and Calling the
2c4206cb-e198-45ab-9387-efe231d61f60.content:
6.B Calling the Score. The score must not be called until the server and receiver
are (or should be) in position and all players are (or should be) ready to play.
The server normally calls the score.

0dd145b4-caba-4da0-9942-650b3a9fe530.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
0dd145b4-caba-4da0-9942-650b3a9fe530.heading: Player Repositioning
0dd145b4-caba-4da0-9942-650b3a9fe530.content:
20.D Player Repositioning. After the score is called, when the serving team
changes serving areas, the referee must stop play, allow all players to
reposition, and re-call the score to restart the 10-second count. (Modifies
Rule 6.D.2)

6a2e92c8-c4ce-47b6-9779-112d48d5ca3b.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
6a2e92c8-c4ce-47b6-9779-112d48d5ca3b.heading: 21.C Medical Time-Out — Between Games
6a2e92c8-c4ce-47b6-9779-112d48d5ca3b.content:
21.C.2 Between Games. Between games, a player may request a
medical time-out, when available, before the start of the next
game.

8735b5bf-aab5-41ac-99fd-28f7bd5f07dd.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
8735b5bf-aab5-41ac-99fd-28f7bd5f07dd.heading: 21.C Medical Time-Out — Valid Medical Condition
8735b5bf-aab5-41ac-99fd-28f7bd5f07dd.content:
21.C.8 Valid Medical Condition. When medical personnel, or the
Tournament Director, when medical personnel are not available,
determine that a valid medical condition exists, the player must
be able to resume play in 15 minutes or less. When the player is
able to resume play in fewer than 15 minutes, the remaining
medical time is lost and no longer available to the player during
the match.

000da7ba-2154-4c84-acf0-c92518527223.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
000da7ba-2154-4c84-acf0-c92518527223.heading: 21.D Referee Time-Out — Referee Discretion
000da7ba-2154-4c84-acf0-c92518527223.content:
21.D.1 Referee Discretion. In the interest of overall safety, when the
referee determines a potential medical situation exists, the
referee is authorized to call a referee time-out and summon
medical personnel, or the Tournament Director when medical
personnel are not available.

8f8fdf7c-3bcc-4501-953a-6cceb1f5d60c.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
8f8fdf7c-3bcc-4501-953a-6cceb1f5d60c.heading: 21.A Standard Time-Out — Between Games
8f8fdf7c-3bcc-4501-953a-6cceb1f5d60c.content:
21.A.3 Between Games. Between games, players may request to use
one or both standard time-outs before the start of the next
game. The players must inform the referee. The standard time-
out will start immediately after the expiration of the time-out
between games. A time-out must be charged when any portion
of the time is used. When the requesting singles player or
doubles team is ready to resume play before a requested time-
out begins, that time-out is not charged.

282fa8f4-d1bf-4351-902a-29507ea31937.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
282fa8f4-d1bf-4351-902a-29507ea31937.heading: Extending Time to Report to Match
282fa8f4-d1bf-4351-902a-29507ea31937.content:
16.M Extending Time to Report to Match. The Tournament Director may allow
an extension of time for players to report to a match when circumstances
warrant.

46924f02-0491-4481-9f9c-8e7aaac34452.title: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
46924f02-0491-4481-9f9c-8e7aaac34452.content:
4.7. A player whose individual rating exceeds the Division maximum at the beginning of the
season is strictly prohibited from participating in that Division. If a Player rises above the
maximum during the season, they may complete that season in that Division.
4.8. A player whose individual rating is below the Division minimum at the beginning of the
season is strictly prohibited from participating in that Division. If a Player goes below the
minimum during the season, they may complete that season in that Division.

3509e40c-54f6-4952-b7fe-c305ba18a616.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
3509e40c-54f6-4952-b7fe-c305ba18a616.heading: 25.B Adaptive Standing Play — Player Eligibility
3509e40c-54f6-4952-b7fe-c305ba18a616.content:
25.B.1 Player Eligibility. Adaptive standing players must have a
permanent physical disability that significantly affects their
mobility, balance, or coordination, and not use a wheelchair
during play. Examples include, but are not limited to, players
with lower-limb amputation above the knee, limb difference,
cerebral palsy, stroke, neurological or orthopedic conditions
that affect movement coordination, severe balance limitations,
or spinal cord injury with ambulatory function, and players using
crutches or braces who cannot move quickly to the ball. Players
with below-knee amputations or minor impairments without
significant balance or mobility limitations are eligible as
adaptive standing players but are not eligible for the two-
bounce allowance option (see Rule 25.B.3.a.)

06c7633b-79d3-4c4e-a5eb-48a34fd8970b.title: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
06c7633b-79d3-4c4e-a5eb-48a34fd8970b.heading: DUPR LEAGUE MANAGERS
06c7633b-79d3-4c4e-a5eb-48a34fd8970b.content:

become unfrozen. This freeze-and-unfreeze process shall continue as necessary
until one team wins the game by two (2) points. The game-winning point must
always be scored while serving.

7984245c-3a8b-47cc-8f56-97cfa2a7106c.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
7984245c-3a8b-47cc-8f56-97cfa2a7106c.heading: 21.A Standard Time-Out — Resuming Play
7984245c-3a8b-47cc-8f56-97cfa2a7106c.content:
21.A.6 Resuming Play. The referee will resume play by announcing a
15-second warning (Rule 17.D.16).

862b4b5e-4aec-45b1-aab0-10bf38742e74.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
862b4b5e-4aec-45b1-aab0-10bf38742e74.heading: 21.E Equipment Time-Out — Resuming Play
862b4b5e-4aec-45b1-aab0-10bf38742e74.content:
21.E.2 Resuming Play. The referee will resume play by announcing a
15-second warning (Rule 17.D.16).

e7dbeff3-7125-4f39-a2e3-8d0e1656f8f1.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
e7dbeff3-7125-4f39-a2e3-8d0e1656f8f1.heading: 17.D Officiating Play — Score Calls
e7dbeff3-7125-4f39-a2e3-8d0e1656f8f1.content:
17.D.2 Score Calls. Call the score to start each rally after confirming that
the correct server has the ball (see Rule 6.B). Calling the score
indicates to all players that play is ready to resume.

b04b80e9-c26f-4f8a-8b6e-63965613a12e.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
b04b80e9-c26f-4f8a-8b6e-63965613a12e.heading: 21.C Medical Time-Out — Resuming Play
b04b80e9-c26f-4f8a-8b6e-63965613a12e.content:
21.C.11 Resuming Play. The referee will resume play by announcing a
15-second warning (Rule 17.D.16).

1b1bbfa1-82e0-42a5-973d-406cbcd29c6b.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
1b1bbfa1-82e0-42a5-973d-406cbcd29c6b.heading: 17.D Officiating Play — Appealed Calls
1b1bbfa1-82e0-42a5-973d-406cbcd29c6b.content:
17.D.11 Appealed Calls. Rule on other calls appealed by players. The
referee may consult players and line judges to decide the
outcome of any appeal.

8024fe3a-5235-4738-9175-3caa74c94785.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
8024fe3a-5235-4738-9175-3caa74c94785.heading: 17.D Officiating Play — Player Conduct
8024fe3a-5235-4738-9175-3caa74c94785.content:
17.D.17 Player Conduct. Monitor and manage player conduct. The
referee is empowered to call verbal warnings, technical
warnings, and technical fouls, and to forfeit games and matches
based on a defined combination of technical warnings and/or
technical fouls. The referee may also recommend ejection of a
player to the Tournament Director. (See Section 22.)

465bc5ba-f3e9-43e2-8bb2-3dd714c21131.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
465bc5ba-f3e9-43e2-8bb2-3dd714c21131.heading: 17.D Officiating Play — Time-Outs
465bc5ba-f3e9-43e2-8bb2-3dd714c21131.content:
17.D.15 Time-Outs. Enforce time-out procedures. (See Section 21.)
17.D.16 15-Second Warnings. Announce when there are 15 seconds
remaining in a time-out. At the end of the 15 seconds, the referee
must call “time in” and then the score when all players are ready
to play or should be ready to play.

eddd9671-4b0f-4883-bfe4-2c604ea7bc0f.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
eddd9671-4b0f-4883-bfe4-2c604ea7bc0f.heading: 17.D Officiating Play — Side Out Calls
eddd9671-4b0f-4883-bfe4-2c604ea7bc0f.content:
17.D.5 Side Out Calls. Announce “side out” when a singles player or
second server loses the serve.

271b2c39-8fd7-4785-8b56-4078b74c667f.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
271b2c39-8fd7-4785-8b56-4078b74c667f.heading: 25.A Wheelchair Play — Two-Bounce Allowance
271b2c39-8fd7-4785-8b56-4078b74c667f.content:
25.A.9 Two-Bounce Allowance. A wheelchair player may allow the ball
to bounce twice before returning the ball. The second bounce
can be anywhere on the playing surface. (Modifies Rule 10.B)

173c78cf-bb5c-4368-93fa-382865a45947.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
173c78cf-bb5c-4368-93fa-382865a45947.heading: Hinders
173c78cf-bb5c-4368-93fa-382865a45947.section: Section 9: Dead Balls, Faults, and Hinders
173c78cf-bb5c-4368-93fa-382865a45947.content: 9.C Hinders. A called hinder results in a dead ball.

ff9b2ee6-6e46-4d32-8d90-d44c374f6756.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
ff9b2ee6-6e46-4d32-8d90-d44c374f6756.heading: 9.B Faults — Fault Call Responsibility
ff9b2ee6-6e46-4d32-8d90-d44c374f6756.section: Section 9: Dead Balls, Faults, and Hinders
ff9b2ee6-6e46-4d32-8d90-d44c374f6756.content:
9.B.2 Fault Call Responsibility. Players are expected to call faults on
themselves or on their partner as soon as the fault is committed or
detected.

8cbed2a3-904c-4f2b-b823-3faa51ae7d68.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
8cbed2a3-904c-4f2b-b823-3faa51ae7d68.heading: 17.D Officiating Play — Replay Calls
8cbed2a3-904c-4f2b-b823-3faa51ae7d68.content: 17.D.9 Replay Calls. Call replays as appropriate. (See Appendix A.2.)

7a4b2385-1a4b-4344-ac7c-4f189168cd67.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
7a4b2385-1a4b-4344-ac7c-4f189168cd67.heading: Stopping a Rally
7a4b2385-1a4b-4344-ac7c-4f189168cd67.section: Section 9: Dead Balls, Faults, and Hinders
7a4b2385-1a4b-4344-ac7c-4f189168cd67.content: 9.A Stopping a Rally. Any action that stops play results in a dead ball.

758fc8fb-7e2d-47de-ad97-fd927b9e1844.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
758fc8fb-7e2d-47de-ad97-fd927b9e1844.heading: 9.C Hinders — Replay – Hinder
758fc8fb-7e2d-47de-ad97-fd927b9e1844.section: Section 9: Dead Balls, Faults, and Hinders
758fc8fb-7e2d-47de-ad97-fd927b9e1844.content:
9.C.2 Replay – Hinder. When a hinder is called, the rally must be
replayed.

9c48f564-065c-485d-a958-d153524ee61d.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
9c48f564-065c-485d-a958-d153524ee61d.heading: 9.C Hinders — Who Can Call Hinder
9c48f564-065c-485d-a958-d153524ee61d.section: Section 9: Dead Balls, Faults, and Hinders
9c48f564-065c-485d-a958-d153524ee61d.content: 9.C.1 Who Can Call Hinder. Any player may call a hinder.

f1d57c7b-cdaa-40c6-93e2-f8ef480976cc.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
f1d57c7b-cdaa-40c6-93e2-f8ef480976cc.heading: Hinder
f1d57c7b-cdaa-40c6-93e2-f8ef480976cc.content:
20.H Hinder. The referee must validate a hinder called by a player. (Modifies
Rule 9.C.2)

e1113b56-1bca-439b-86c5-149d487a8576.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
e1113b56-1bca-439b-86c5-149d487a8576.heading: 9.B.3 Calling Non-Volley Zone Faults and Service Foot Faults on — Disagreement Between Partners
e1113b56-1bca-439b-86c5-149d487a8576.section: Section 9: Dead Balls, Faults, and Hinders
e1113b56-1bca-439b-86c5-149d487a8576.content:
9.B.3.c Disagreement Between Partners. Any disagreement
between partners on a fault call will be decided to the
benefit of their opponents.

d297bac3-4aac-4d3e-acfd-a44e1e1e9d89.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
d297bac3-4aac-4d3e-acfd-a44e1e1e9d89.heading: 17.D Officiating Play — Point Calls
d297bac3-4aac-4d3e-acfd-a44e1e1e9d89.content: 17.D.3 Point Calls. Call “point” after each point is awarded.

a7037cfe-8bca-4fbb-a9c0-fe1e2a33ed64.title: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR Captains Guide
a7037cfe-8bca-4fbb-a9c0-fe1e2a33ed64.heading: ALL-STAR TOURNAMENT
a7037cfe-8bca-4fbb-a9c0-fe1e2a33ed64.content:
ALL-STAR TOURNAMENT
o The League will hold an All-Star Tournament between seasons. This will be communicated to
all captains prior to Fall/Winter or Winter/Spring season break.
o Each team that participated in the previous season may nominate two players for the All-Star
Tournament. Participation in this tournament is optional, and teams are not obligated to
compete.
o All regular season eligibility standards, ratings and rules apply and will be based on the previous
season.
o These games will not be posted to DUPR.
o A double-elimination tournament will determine the All-Star Champs for each Division.
o The League will award medals to Gold/1st place winners in each Division.

0c0c5dce-8106-4bfe-bb44-92ecbb48a73c.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
0c0c5dce-8106-4bfe-bb44-92ecbb48a73c.heading: 15.C.1 Standard Scoring Formats — One game to 15 or 21 points.

2acff5ec-8f67-4a41-9320-1eb3cf91cdd8.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
2acff5ec-8f67-4a41-9320-1eb3cf91cdd8.heading: Standard Time-Out
2acff5ec-8f67-4a41-9320-1eb3cf91cdd8.content:
21.A Standard Time-Out. Two standard time-outs are allowed per singles
player or doubles team for each 11-point and 15-point game and three
time-outs for a 21-point game.

f776739e-e025-42b8-a2c6-22a368fa7ac0.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
f776739e-e025-42b8-a2c6-22a368fa7ac0.heading: 22.E Technical Foul Consequences — Score Adjustment
f776739e-e025-42b8-a2c6-22a368fa7ac0.content:
22.E.1 Score Adjustment. When a technical foul is assessed against a
singles player or doubles team, one point will be deducted from
the score of the offending player or team. When the offender’s
score is zero, one point will be added to the opponent’s score.
The player or team whose score is adjusted must move to their
correct position(s) based on their new score. A point adjustment
due to assessment of a technical foul that results in a game-
winning score applies regardless of who was serving during the
preceding rally.

b155a475-67e6-4e59-8dca-694c560a2f75.title: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
b155a475-67e6-4e59-8dca-694c560a2f75.heading: Match Format
b155a475-67e6-4e59-8dca-694c560a2f75.content:
6.3.3. Match Format: Teams play Round Robin. 2 out of 3 to 11 (win by 2). Plus, potential
Picklebreaker to 11 (win by 2). Teams will switch ends for game 2. Teams only
switch ends during a game if they play a 3rd game and when the first team reaches
6 points. Visitors choose serve, receive, side, or defer in game 1 and 3. Two one-
minute timeouts per team/game but no timeouts in Picklebreaker game.

858943dd-40d8-4c17-ac84-26e5c915daa5.title: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
858943dd-40d8-4c17-ac84-26e5c915daa5.content:
6.3.9. Teams starting the season with fewer scheduled games than others in their
Division/Pool will receive compensatory points at the end of the season. These
points will be calculated based on the team’s average points earned per match
date, rounded to the nearest whole number (0.5 and above rounds up; 0.4 and
below rounds down).

cdea6464-5e16-4ab1-a424-43b3f196649b.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
cdea6464-5e16-4ab1-a424-43b3f196649b.heading: 17.D Officiating Play — Fault Calls
cdea6464-5e16-4ab1-a424-43b3f196649b.content: 17.D.8 Fault Calls. Identify and call rule violations when they occur.

b7ef08d2-387f-4100-8b1c-60af2a258273.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
b7ef08d2-387f-4100-8b1c-60af2a258273.heading: 17.D Officiating Play — Scoresheet Annotations
b7ef08d2-387f-4100-8b1c-60af2a258273.content:
17.D.6 Scoresheet Annotations. Appropriately annotate the scoresheet
after a rally is completed or a time-out is called.

e3710672-e146-4d29-b2e5-5eb8203528b7.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
e3710672-e146-4d29-b2e5-5eb8203528b7.heading: Stop Play Indicators
e3710672-e146-4d29-b2e5-5eb8203528b7.section: Section 6: Player Readiness and Calling the
e3710672-e146-4d29-b2e5-5eb8203528b7.content:
6.E Stop Play Indicators. After the start of the score call, verbal indicators to
stop play such as “stop” and “wait” will be recognized.

dd0c441d-85f4-48af-813c-94a10743f62d.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
dd0c441d-85f4-48af-813c-94a10743f62d.heading: Officiating Play
dd0c441d-85f4-48af-813c-94a10743f62d.content: 17.D Officiating Play. During the match, the referee must:

de9ab654-63eb-49ef-8450-4f6c84e64510.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
de9ab654-63eb-49ef-8450-4f6c84e64510.heading: 21.A Standard Time-Out — Before Start of Match
de9ab654-63eb-49ef-8450-4f6c84e64510.content:
21.A.1 Before Start of Match. A standard time-out cannot be called
before a match starts.

98ca9f86-2eee-4ac2-9c0d-9b91f7df8b18.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
98ca9f86-2eee-4ac2-9c0d-9b91f7df8b18.heading: 21.C Medical Time-Out — Before Start of Match
98ca9f86-2eee-4ac2-9c0d-9b91f7df8b18.content:
21.C.1 Before Start of Match. A medical time-out cannot be called
before the start of a match.

9d5ab0dd-453d-408d-8e92-d94d276470b4.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
9d5ab0dd-453d-408d-8e92-d94d276470b4.heading: 21.F Time-Out Between Games — Duration
9d5ab0dd-453d-408d-8e92-d94d276470b4.content:
21.F.1 Duration. A maximum of two minutes is allowed to change ends
between games.

56207e32-1182-4f74-bfb1-b28a0dd6e758.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
56207e32-1182-4f74-bfb1-b28a0dd6e758.heading: 21.C Medical Time-Out — Time Start
56207e32-1182-4f74-bfb1-b28a0dd6e758.content:
21.C.7 Time Start. When medical assistance arrives, the referee will
start a 15-minute timer. Play must resume as soon as possible
but no later than 15 minutes of elapsed time.

18d12ed1-1433-433d-a153-15cd84117924.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
18d12ed1-1433-433d-a153-15cd84117924.heading: 21.C Medical Time-Out — Match Retirement
18d12ed1-1433-433d-a153-15cd84117924.content:
21.C.9 Match Retirement. A match retirement is imposed when a
player is not able to continue play after the 15-minute medical
time-out period expires. A player may use their available
standard time-outs to allow more time before the match must
be retired (Rule 21.A.4). In doubles, if the retiring player's partner
decides to continue, the match will resume following all
applicable rules. The retiring player must leave the playing
surface.

7cdebb34-c8b6-4cc1-b12c-3bfa898df676.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
7cdebb34-c8b6-4cc1-b12c-3bfa898df676.heading: Use of Time-Outs Between Games
7cdebb34-c8b6-4cc1-b12c-3bfa898df676.content:
24.E Use of Time-Outs Between Games. Players must notify the opponent of
their intent to use one or both standard time-outs before the start of the
next game. (Modifies Rule 21.A.3)

4f894e64-6de1-4d8a-adc0-0255ae2a30a3.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
4f894e64-6de1-4d8a-adc0-0255ae2a30a3.heading: 21.A Standard Time-Out — After Medical Time-Out
4f894e64-6de1-4d8a-adc0-0255ae2a30a3.content:
21.A.4 After Medical Time-Out. A player may use available standard
time-outs after the expiration of a medical time-out.

23083b78-255d-4fc6-9a57-2263dd4a5d40.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
23083b78-255d-4fc6-9a57-2263dd4a5d40.heading: Time-Out Between Games
23083b78-255d-4fc6-9a57-2263dd4a5d40.content:
21.F Time-Out Between Games. The referee will call a time-out between
games of a match.

b7513d97-f64c-499f-9933-e2fce4560042.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
b7513d97-f64c-499f-9933-e2fce4560042.heading: Medical Time-Out
b7513d97-f64c-499f-9933-e2fce4560042.content:
21.C Medical Time-Out. A player needing medical attention during a match,
including between games, may request a medical time-out.

aff27a49-365b-4ca3-877d-9a0316b7d2e8.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
aff27a49-365b-4ca3-877d-9a0316b7d2e8.heading: 21.C Medical Time-Out — Duration
aff27a49-365b-4ca3-877d-9a0316b7d2e8.content:
21.C.6 Duration. A maximum of 15 minutes is allowed for a medical
time-out. However, when medical treatment is rendered off-
court at another location at the venue, the time to transport the
player to and from the off-court location will be excluded from
15-minute time period.

ee3c6726-0d0e-4476-b594-df1df227343f.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
ee3c6726-0d0e-4476-b594-df1df227343f.heading: Referee Time-Out
ee3c6726-0d0e-4476-b594-df1df227343f.content:
21.D Referee Time-Out. The referee may call a referee time-out to address
extenuating circumstances that require an extended interruption of play
and summon assistance, as necessary. When designated personnel are
not available, the Tournament Director will respond. Extenuating
circumstances include, but are not limited to, those cited in this section.

c8642e31-30ef-4167-ba0d-3ffb1023c08a.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
c8642e31-30ef-4167-ba0d-3ffb1023c08a.heading: 21.C Medical Time-Out — Rescinding Medical Time-Out Request
c8642e31-30ef-4167-ba0d-3ffb1023c08a.content:
21.C.4 Rescinding Medical Time-Out Request. If the player rescinds
the medical time-out after the medical personnel have been
called and before they have arrived, a standard time-out will be
charged and the medical time-out will not be charged. When a
standard time-out is not available, the referee will assess a
technical foul against the player or team for delay of game.

bf4c228e-2481-4b77-8687-d5d7d0b864db.title: 2026 USA Pickleball Official Rulebook
bf4c228e-2481-4b77-8687-d5d7d0b864db.heading: 21.A Standard Time-Out — Requesting Time-Out
bf4c228e-2481-4b77-8687-d5d7d0b864db.content:
21.A.2 Requesting Time-Out. Any player may call a time-out between
rallies before the next serve occurs or between games. The time-
out must be called audibly by voice or visibly by hand signal, or
both, and must be directed toward the opposing player or team
and to the referee.
